sections.heading: Come train with us on South Lamar

items.q: I've never done CrossFit. Can I still join?
items.a: Absolutely. Every membership starts with a free intro and our Foundations program, where a coach teaches you every movement at your pace before you join group classes.

items.q: How do I schedule my free trial?
items.a: Book your free intro online — pick a time that works and we'll meet you at the gym for a conversation and a light workout. No pressure, no obligation.

items.q: Do you offer drop-ins for visitors?
items.a: Yes — experienced athletes visiting Austin are welcome. Book a drop-in online and come train with us.

items.q: Can I pause or cancel my membership?
items.a: Any time, no games. Pause or cancel from your member portal or just email us — it's handled within one business day.

seo.title: About Us | Iron Anchor Austin
seo.description: Iron Anchor is an independent strength and conditioning gym on South Lamar, Austin — built around coaching, community, and consistency since 2017.

sections.heading: Built in Austin, for Austin
sections.body: Iron Anchor opened in 2017 with a squat rack, a rowing machine, and a conviction: fitness sticks when it's coached, personal, and actually fun. Nine years later we're 400 members strong and still independent — every program written in-house, every class capped so coaches can coach.
